name: Shain Carrasco
tagline: Software developer in Chicago. Research at the SkAI Institute, Climb Intel, D1 Hoops, Upset, WildAtlas and LipRead.
bannerLine: Software developer in Chicago. Research at the SkAI Institute, Climb Intel, D1 Hoops, Upset, WildAtlas and LipRead.

work.title: Climb Intel
work.line: Grades Kilter Board routes and predicts how hard a climb will feel for your body. Video coaching from phone clips. 72.8% of held-out climbs graded within one V-grade.

work.title: D1 Hoops
work.line: Power ratings and game predictions for all 365 D-I basketball teams, graded in public every day. The same chart engine runs tennis, soccer and football. 78.3% of 568 out-of-sample game picks right this season (walk-forward backtest).

work.title: Upset
work.line: Every fantasy matchup in your league as a live win probability, priced 1¢ to 99¢. Play coins only.

work.title: WildAtlas
work.line: A 3D globe of life on Earth: biomes, species, and findings mined from research papers. Record what you see.

work.title: LipRead
work.line: Read the lips in a sports clip, on your phone, with nothing uploaded.

work.title: HoopLab
work.line: Free college basketball analytics: team and player ratings from play-by-play, with its own predictions graded in public.

work.title: Roblox games
work.line: Be a Stone, published on Roblox, and Scrap City, an urban survival game in development. 13 worlds in Be a Stone, each generated by a build script.

work.title: dowse, tripwire, catchup
work.line: Dependency-free tools: vault search for my agents, a secret scanner, a scheduler for a laptop that sleeps. 139 of 139 planted secrets found, 0 false alarms.
